comments.text: So a big wedding can actually affect how much respect a man gets in his community? That's a lot of pressure for one celebration. I wonder how younger people feel about this tradition. 🤔🤔🤔🤔

replies.author: @ImpossiblePlacesGlobal
replies.text: In fact it's still a complex issue, as some young people are starting to question the necessity of such expensive traditions in the face of modern economic challenges 🤔

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Living in Grande Comore must be an experience unlike anywhere else. Imagine growing up surrounded by the ocean, an active volcano, and traditions passed down through generations. I'd love to hear from someone who lives there: what is the one thing about island life that outsiders would never understand?
